item.title: Nancy Pelosi takes final bow as California Democrats’ ‘forever speaker’
item.description: She's leaving Congress after 39 years, but Nancy Pelosi proved she can still command a room full of California Democrats like no one else.

item.title: California wants millions of heat pumps. High power bills might get in the way
item.description: California wants to slash greenhouse gases by electrifying homes and installing six million heat pumps by 2030. Lawmakers are pushing new policies to speed adoption. But some of the nation’s highest electricity rates stand in the way.

item.title: Why these California counties are directly funding immigrant legal defense amid Trump’s crackdown
item.description: California has funded immigrant legal defense against deportation for a decade. Now, more cities and counties are kicking in money, too.

item.title: Gavin Newsom’s last budget belies his ‘California for All’ pledge
item.description: The 2026-27 proposal fails to respond to President Donald Trump’s cuts. Nor does it help families meet needs for housing, food and health care.

item.title: ‘What the hell is going on?’: Democratic leaders clash over congressional endorsement
item.description: Sen. Mike McGuire accused Democratic Party Chair Rusty Hicks of trying to block his endorsement despite the backing of 74% of delegates.

item.title: CA Democrats can’t agree on endorsement for governor. Will Republicans benefit?
item.description: The California Democratic Party’s state convention wrapped up Sunday in San Francisco, concluding a three-day event in which 3,500 delegates chose some of their party endorsements for the June 2 primary election. item.title: California amplía servicios para inmigrantes en medio de campaña de deportación de Trump
item.description: California mantiene el apoyo a la defensa legal de los inmigrantes que enfrentan la deportación a pesar de un presupuesto estatal ajustado y proyecciones que indican déficit.

item.title: Por qué estos condados de California financian directamente la defensa legal de migrantes en medio de la represión de Trump
item.description: California ha financiado la defensa legal de inmigrantes contra la deportación durante una década. Ahora, más ciudades y condados también están aportando fondos.

item.title: Mexico takes out ‘El Mencho’: What the violence could mean for the U.S. border
item.description: Violence broke out in at least a dozen Mexican states after the slaying of a cartel kingpin known as 'El Mencho'. The instability could drive migrants to the U.S. border.
